verdict.rationale: Kushki's own docs cover online card acceptance: one-time card payments, an accept-a-payment guide, test data and moving to production. It also offers low-code paths such as Smartlink payment links, a hosted payment button, the Kajita checkout form and e-commerce plugins, plus an aggregator model that could ease onboarding. Nothing in the pack shows how long signup, approval or activation takes, so the 'within a day' part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documented signup-to-live timeline or self-serve instant activation, merchant approval/KYC turnaround, independent or hands-on corroboration of fast onboarding.
